aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was started by Dominic Bonini, who created Village Foodie to find out which food trucks would be coming to his village. It is a small company and he runs it himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I got to know, the more I believed they deserved better tools: something made for a business that is somewhere else every day, not for a restaurant with a fixed address. That is why I started HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It is a small company and I run it myself. If you contact us, I will answer you myself, not a support queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks come, but I never knew which one would come or when, unless I searched on Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I made Village Foodie, a simple way to see which food trucks are coming to the villages near you.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Customers can order for a future date or time before the event.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at the same time and how much time you need. When a collection time fills up, customers cannot choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: On the phone in your apron, on the tablet on the counter, on the laptop inside the food truck — and on the card machine you already take payment with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You are somewhere else every week, at different times, with unstable or no mobile signal. HatchGrab was made exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal is lost, online orders stop automatically, so customers do not send orders you will not see. Keep accepting orders with the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook & Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Fewer queues and food ready as soon as they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp answers while you drive to your spot or stand at the grill, based on your own menu and your schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will answer while you drive to your spot or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or a screenshot of your menu and in under 60 seconds we will turn it into a working ordering page for you to try. Your own items, your own prices. No signup, no card, no installation. Take a look and then decide.
